## Wave 3 Summary

This wave resolves the two genuine Q1a adjudications of the inv-9 cluster (`Investigating-Workshops.md` §"A WORKSHOP IS": TWO agents, opposed first-principles readings of a SPECIFIC tension, multi-round R1-steelman / R2-rebuttal-converge, output a STRUCTURAL VERDICT). It translates the seed's two adversarial convergences: (1) the **sum-over-geometries / Page-curve / information** tension (seed §"Thesis" convergence 2 — kaku reads the GGE Fock trace AS the sum, string reads the framework as categorically forgoing `∫Dg`), and (2) the **substrate QG-character lens** tension (seed §"Thesis" third theme — kitaev reads the substrate as measured-integrable and rules black-hole/holographic imports illegitimate, LQG reads it as the background-independent-QG cousin where some cross-QG imports are structural). Both gates are `gate_type: workshop` (EXACTLY 2 agents, 2 rounds). The wave is **owner-planned by a NEUTRAL agent** (gen-physicist) precisely because the W1/W2 wave-owners (kaku, string) participate in W3-1 and the two reused agents (kitaev, LQG) participate in W3-2 — no wave-owner plans a workshop they argue in (the inv-3/4/5/7/8/10 W4 neutral-planner precedent). Gate-type mix: **workshop × 2**, no compute, no review.

Prerequisite disposition (workshop prereqs reference upstream deliverables, NOT verdict-file gate IDs):

- **INV9-W3-1** is *sharpened by* the INV9-W1-5 (GGE Fock partition function, Page-curve) compute verdict and *by* inv-10 W3-1 (GGE-projection Born rule) IF landed at dispatch — both are evidence the workshop adjudicates. Neither STRICTLY blocks: the kaku B-5 / string C-1 readings and the kitaev λ_L=0 diagnostic already exist on disk (CHAOS-2/CHAOS-3, S38/S65/S104). Per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`, if a prereq deliverable is unlanded at dispatch, the workshop runs on the standing readings + the λ_L=0 evidence and notes the INV9-W1-5 / inv-10-W3-1 verdicts as "pending — cite if landed". This is NOT an upstream-block closure (the workshop has sufficient standing evidence); it is a conditional-citation note.
- **INV9-W3-2** is *independent of all compute verdicts* — it adjudicates the LENS, not a number. Its shared evidence (the λ_L=0 chaos diagnostics, the acoustic-white-hole / surface-gravity / §VII.BZ horizon apparatus, the LQG structural-parallel surveys) is entirely on disk. No prerequisite gates the workshop.

Cross-investigation boundary (load-bearing, both gates): W3-2 does NOT re-open the kitaev computes consumed by inv-10 (INV10-W3-1..4) or the LQG computes consumed by inv-7 (INV7-W3-1/W3-2/W3-3, INV7-W4-1) — it adjudicates the cross-framework reading.     NEUTRAL SPEC — gen-physicist authored, NOT a participant (feedback_review-dispatch-no-orchestrator-angle.md).
    No orchestrator angle, no planner angle: kitaev brings the measured-integrability reading,
    LQG brings the background-independent-QG reading; the spec frames the contested lens and the
    import ruling evenly and privileges neither. Format scaffolding is fine; substance-steering is
    forbidden. NOTE the lens itself is the contested object — the spec must NOT assert in advance
    that one lens is correct, nor that the two are necessarily competing (the orthogonal-axes
    resolution in sub-question (c) is left genuinely open).

    Round protocol (2 rounds):
    - R1 (steelman): kitaev writes the strongest first-principles case for Reading K (measured-
      integrability; λ_L=0 / non-holographic / no SYK-JT dual; emergence in integrability
      machinery; black-hole/holographic imports illegitimate). LQG writes the strongest case for
      Reading L (continuous-g_M background-independent-QG cousin; effective-Friedmann / isolated-
      horizon-entropy / GFT structural parallels; discrete-vs-continuous divide). Each steelmans
      its OWN lens in R1 — no rebuttal yet.
    - R2 (respond + converge): each advocate responds to the opponent's R1 best case, then the
      pair converges on the STRUCTURAL VERDICT for (c) — the QG-character classification + the
      machinery-import ruling, OR (if the lenses are orthogonal) the axis on which each is correct.

    Numeric / structural stakes both advocates must engage:
    - λ_L = 0 across 4 functionals (CHAOS-2/CHAOS-3 DIAGNOSTIC: ORDERED; OTOC ~ t^{1.9};
      ⟨r⟩=0.367 Poisson, Type III₁ modular flow) — kitaev's load-bearing measured-integrability
      evidence; LQG must engage whether integrability precludes the QG-cousin reading.
    - The substrate horizon apparatus: acoustic white hole PROVEN S85 (causal-disconnect,
      pre/post-fold causally separated); the §VII.BZ modular corridor; the KIND-tagged surface-
      gravity ledger; emergent g_M from the a₂ Seeley-DeWitt coefficient — the horizon object
      whose correct reading is the adjudicated lens.
    - LQG's structural parallels: effective-Friedmann (the §6.3 substrate→FRW gap), isolated-
      horizon entropy S ∝ A/4G_eff, GFT condensate → resummed a₀ — the candidate legitimate
      imports; kitaev must rule on whether each survives the λ_L=0 / non-holographic constraint.

    Adjudication rule: the verdict is a STRUCTURAL classification + an import ruling the substrate's
    own machinery supports, NOT a vote and NOT an appeal to programme maturity. Restating either
    survey is not a verdict (epistemic-discipline.md §"What Does NOT Count as Evidence").
    Substrate-first framing throughout: GR / black-hole-thermodynamics / holography are emergent
    CONSEQUENCES on this substrate, not premises — the import ruling decides which emergent-physics
    machinery the substrate actually generates, never explains the substrate via GR
    (phononic-framing.md §"IS Space, Not IN Space").

    CROSS-INVESTIGATION BOUNDARY (load-bearing, seed §"DEDUP" + partition §"Reused-agent note"):
    W3-2 ADJUDICATES THE LENS — it does NOT re-open the consumed computes. kitaev's integrability
    suite is consumed by inv-10 (INV10-W3-1 GGE-projection Born rule; INV10-W3-2 RP-resonances;
    INV10-W3-3 Σ²/SFF rigidity; INV10-W3-4 ETH-violation). LQG's full top-5 is consumed by inv-7
    (UB-1 = INV7-W4-1 LQC effective-Friedmann; UB-2/UB-4 = INV7-W3-1 modular-horizon entropy;
    UB-3 = INV7-W3-2 GFT condensate → a₀; UB-5 = INV7-W3-3 LQC pre-inflationary overlay). This
    workshop is the genuine FRESH inv-9 role for the two reused agents — the cross-framework-QG
    LENS adjudication (the inv-5 spectral-geometer reduced-role precedent, applied twice). The
    workshop cites those computes as STANDING RESULTS where relevant but does NOT re-derive them;
    a re-derivation would be redundant with inv-7 / inv-10 and is out of scope.

---

## Wave 3 → (Investigation Close) Decision Point

Wave 3 has no downstream investigation wave (it is the terminal wave; W1/W2 are the compute waves and run alongside or before it). Its outputs feed the investigation-close synthesis (`/rclab-investigate --investigation 9`) and, where a verdict promotes, the session pipeline:

- **INV9-W3-1 landed** with a shared structural reading (hidden-Fock-sum OR categorical-no-sum) → the reading is a candidate for the Ordered-Veil information-story status in the capstone / atlas-04 (session-promotion + designated-writer patch; an investigation cannot mutate curated session-track registers per `gate-verdicts.md §"Track-local boundary"`). Landed with an irreducible fork → the discriminating compute is a carry-forward to a session-mode `/rclab-plan` (the workshop's Carry-Forward Computations block).
- **INV9-W3-1 landed** bearing on the Q7 SUM-vs-NO-SUM prior → if the verdict sharpens or revises the standing Q7 position, that is a session-track reconciliation (the Q7 workshop lives under session-96), routed at close — NOT an investigation edit.
- **INV9-W3-2 landed** with a QG-character classification + import ruling → the ruling on which black-hole/holographic/QG machinery legitimately applies is a candidate atlas-04 assumption-tag reconciliation (e.g., the §6.3 effective-Friedmann gap status, the isolated-horizon-entropy import) — session-promotion. The cross-refs to inv-7 (LQG computes) + inv-10 (kitaev computes) are preserved so the ruling cites those standing results without re-opening them.
- Both workshops landing an **INFO/orthogonal-fork** outcome is a valid terminal state — the fork (W3-1) or the axis-decomposition + import boundary (W3-2) is the structural deliverable, carried forward as named.

No Wave-3 outcome blocks any other wave (W3 is terminal; W1/W2 are independent compute waves).

## Wave 3 Machinery-Enumeration Pin

Both gates are `gate_type: workshop` — neither has a producing script, so neither contributes a `machinery_pin_map` entry. There is NO compute/solo subset in this wave; `_yaml_gate_validator.py`'s numeric-PRDR path reads nothing here (the workshop blocks set the numeric PRDR items to N/A per the S95 non-compute-gate clause of `r3-yaml-gate-block.yaml`). The wave's real pre-registration is the two `workshop:` blocks + their artifact-existence `output_artifacts`, validated by the artifact-existence path, NOT the numeric validator suite (`r3-yaml-gate-block.yaml` gate_type-dependence note; `wave-classification.md §M1`).
